Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidence after credible sources (Holland.com and Wikipedia) explicitly stated that people wear orange on Koningsdag/Oranjegekte. It incorrectly concluded that red-white-blue are the primary clothing colors with orange only as an accent, conflating flag protocol with attire customs. This overgeneralization contradicted the sources and led to redundant searches instead of accepting the clear, correct answer (orange).
